name: Intent Router
description: Analyzes the user question against SQL table metadata and decides SQL-based, Semantic-based, Both-dependent, or Both-independent analysis, handing off to Quin (Sql_Generator) or Eryl (Eryl_agent).

sub_agents.name: routing_agent
sub_agents.purpose: Classify question and set analysis_type + next_agent.

external_resources: Optional QUIN_TABLE_SCHEMAS / QUIN_TABLE_SCHEMAS_PATH for SQL routing accuracy

statefulness: build_agents() is a factory — call once per conversation/session.
